about: Serving levers a summit path composes (data/paths/<target>.json nodes name them by id; build.py data.paths, src/paths.py). A lever is one choice a recipe makes: an engine, a quant, where the experts live, a decode or prefill mechanism, a scheduler policy. Levers of an exclusive kind (one per recipe: an engine, a quant) never pair with each other; every other pair of levers a target has tried is either composed in some node of that target or listed as never composed. The behaviour levers (habit edits on one model file) are a separate catalog: data/behaviour-levers.json.

kinds.quant: the weight format of the experts
kinds.placement: where the weights live (VRAM, host RAM, another box)
kinds.decode: a per-token decode mechanism (drafts, route trim)
kinds.batching: how several agents share one step
kinds.scheduler: which agent gets a slot when
